question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.**
solution:
The correct answer is: "**had somehow survived**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence is in the past perfect tense, which requires the auxiliary verb "**had**" and the past participle form of the main verb (in this case, "**survived**").
 
• The adverb "**somehow**" indicates that the survival was unexpected or difficult.
 
• The use of "**had somehow survived**" implies that the survival occurred before another past event.

Therefore, the correct answer is option 4.
